# Auralis Natura — Holistic Health

> Science-based holistic health & nutrition coaching by Dr. rer. nat. Desiree Gruber (Barcelona; online worldwide). Understand your body and improve your health sustainably — individual guidance for energy, women's health and everyday wellbeing. This is coaching and education — not medical advice.

## About
- Founder: Dr. rer. nat. Desiree Gruber — doctorate (Dr. rer. nat.) in chemistry (organic and bioorganic); 15+ years in research and the pharmaceutical industry; certified holistic health consultant; women's health specialist; certified yoga & meditation teacher.
- Method: the Auralis Method — Listen, Analyse, Align, Anchor. Evidence before advice; a plan built around the individual.
- Languages: German, English, Spanish. Format: fully online.

## Services
- Clarity (formerly The Root Session) — €199 — a structured starting point: health analysis, a personal written report and a 1:1 review of the results.
- Change (formerly The Bloom) — €399 — a four-week guided programme from analysis into practice.
- Balance (formerly The Flourishing) — €899 — comprehensive twelve-week guidance to anchor nutrition, habits and lifestyle for the long term.
- The Grove — bespoke (request a quote) — corporate nutrition & wellbeing workshops for teams.
- Free intro call, without obligation (the first step).

## Important / scope
- Holistic health and nutrition coaching for general wellbeing and education only. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease and is not a substitute for medical care.
- "Dr." denotes a doctorate in chemistry, not a medical qualification; not a physician and not a registered "dietista-nutricionista". Coaching complements, never replaces, medical care.
